prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production transparent desktop-pet four-pose character sheet for PawSync.
Primary request: create "Knight Cat", a cute full-bodied tiny cream-and-gray fluffy kitten knight based on the supplied reference image. Preserve the distinctive silver medieval armor, cream cape, light tabby kitten fur, pink ear bows, large soft dark kitten eyes and friendly little nose. Simplify it into clean cuddly 2D cartoon sprite art with warm dark outlines and subtle flat shading, rounded paws and short boots. The kitten is the same individual in every pose.
Input image: the supplied photograph is the character identity/outfit reference.
Composition: exactly four separate full-body sprites in an evenly spaced 2x2 grid on a genuinely transparent background; equal cell dimensions, same character size, same baseline, front-facing mild three-quarter angle, generous empty margins, no overlap. The eyes must be visible and in the same general position in every pose, small dark bead eyes without a white sclera.
Top left: neutral knight kitten standing upright with arms relaxed, a short silver sword safely sheathed at the left hip and cape behind.
Top right: typing/tapping pose, kitten's own left armored paw reaching forward/down, other paw relaxed.
Bottom left: typing/tapping pose, kitten's own right armored paw reaching forward/down, opposite paw relaxed.
Bottom right: welcoming file-catching pose, both armored arms open forward/up with rounded cupped paws ready to catch an invisible object.
Constraints: complete head, ears, cape, torso, functional hands and both boots entirely within every cell. No platform, keyboard, text, labels, decorative particles, background scenery, frames, outlines around cells, watermarks or cast shadows. Keep sword sheathed in every pose so both paws can interact safely. Exactly one kitten per cell, four total. Transparent alpha outside characters.
edit_prompt: Edit only the BOTTOM-LEFT kitten in this four-pose transparent Knight Cat character sheet. It currently repeats the same forward paw as the top-right kitten. For the bottom-left kitten ONLY, lower its viewer-left armored paw to rest against its side, and raise/reach the viewer-right armored paw forward and down for a typing tap. Do not mirror the kitten, face, outfit or sword. Keep the sword sheathed at the same hip, pink bow on the same ear, identical size, cell, feet, face and cape. Preserve the other THREE kittens pixel-for-pixel in their existing cells. Exactly four full-bodied kitten poses, same even 2x2 grid, genuinely transparent background, no labels or new objects. The top-right and bottom-left must visibly tap with OPPOSITE hands.
note: Generated poses are adapted artwork; the reference GIF is used to study motion, never rendered or downloaded at runtime.
